lines: Good morning. Please, take a seat.
The director will finish a meeting in a few minutes.
If you need anything while you wait, I'll be here.
If you have any questions about the building, I can point you in the right direction.
What a busy morning...
People keep asking me for old documents.
I thought hardly anyone ever checked the Archive.
Lately, everyone seems to be looking for things from years ago.
Although I suppose it's just a coincidence.
It's strange...
I could swear I used to know where everything was.
Lately, I've had to ask much more often.
Maybe I've been here too many hours and I'm starting to mix everything up.
Sometimes the corridors seem longer than I remember.
Thank goodness Miguel always knows where everything is.
If someone needs an old document, they always end up asking him.
He has an incredible memory for this sort of thing.
I don't know how he manages to remember so many details.
I suppose it's a matter of experience.
It's almost time for the meeting.
Once it's over, everything will go back to normal.
Although this morning has been rather strange...
Well, I'd better not think about it too much.
I'm sorry, I'm busy at the moment.
If you need anything, Reception can help you.
I'll answer your questions as soon as the meeting is over.
Thank you for your patience.
I'm reviewing some documentation.
We can talk once the meeting is over.
There are several matters that require my attention.
I prefer to review everything before giving an answer.
Not yet.
I have a few pending matters to resolve first.
I assure you that everything is under control.
We can talk when the time is right.
Good morning.
I always try to arrive a little early.
I like to go over things calmly before I start.
That way I avoid making mistakes.
I'm reviewing some lists.
I don't know why... but I could swear they used to be different.
Maybe someone updated them and I didn't notice.
Sometimes we work with the same documents for so long that we stop noticing the changes.
I suppose I simply remember it incorrectly.
Sometimes we overthink things.
Our memory isn't perfect either.
I'm sure there's a simple explanation.
Are you here for the interview?
It's quite busy today.
It seems everyone needs something from Management.
It'll be one of those difficult mornings.
I've been organising some old photographs.
It's incredible how many things we end up keeping.
There are pictures I don't even remember seeing before.
I suppose after so many years, we accumulate too many memories.
If you're looking for old documentation, ask Management.
They know better than anyone how everything is organised.
Miguel usually handles those matters.
He always seems to find what the rest of us can't.
I have to finish some reports.
There's always something pending.
Lately, I haven't had a moment to myself.
But well, it's part of the job.
There was something I wanted to check...
I can't remember what it was right now.
That's strange. I had it completely clear in my mind a moment ago.
I must have too many things on my mind.
Never mind.
I'm sure Miguel remembers.
He always seems to know these things.
Although, now that I think about it... maybe he just has more experience than we do.
Yes, that must be it.
